configuration.final_selection: best actual maximum curvature passing all full-grid fixed-metric and physical gates
configuration.optimizer_objective: fixed-stage LP curvature slack and small step norm; no free curvature auxiliary
configuration.SOC_correction_objective: box-width-normalized L1 norm inside a hard infinity radius
configuration.SOC_backtracking_path: x+alpha*p+(alpha/alpha0)^2*w; alpha0 is the actual corrected primary fraction

process_clock_scope: main includes eighteen-input loader; initialization and active metric-reserve SOC separately recorded

same_parameter_Pi_refinement.name: one SOC-accepted physical field, unchanged parameters and target between final angle grids

mixed_grid_short_step_stage.compact_table_semantics: all primary/SOC model, trial and event rows; full coefficients and omitted details remain in the byte-bound full report

SOC_definition.objective: minimize normalized correction L1 norm inside half actual primary infinity-norm radius

SOC_metric_row_reserve.target_formula: max(gamma*max(c_i(x),0),1/1000000) for metric rows; original target otherwise
SOC_metric_row_reserve.floor_units: original c_plus/c_minus Schur metric rows, not eta tolerance
